en.title: 1. Creating a Tournament
en.excerpt: A complete step-by-step walkthrough to creating a new archery tournament, choosing quota tiers, setting venue locations, and configuring event timelines.
en.content:
1. Starting a New Tournament

Creating an event establishes a centralized management workspace for your championship, including category rosters, digital scoring stations, target allocations, and live elimination brackets.

To begin, log in as an organizer and go to Organizer Dashboard > Tournaments (/dashboard/organizer/tournaments), then click the + Create Tournament button at the top right.

2. Selecting Your Quota Package

If prompted, select a participant quota package tailored to your championship scale:

  • Standard Tier: Ideal for local club sparring, open fun shoots, and regional trials.
  • Pro / National Tier: Suitable for multi-day championships with high athlete volume, multiple scoring line devices, and automated live results streaming.

(Note: Active subscribers can launch new tournaments immediately without manual quota checkout.)

3. Event Details & Venue Location

Complete the basic competition details on the setup form:

  1. Tournament Name: The official championship title (e.g., Jakarta Open Archery Championship 2026).
  2. Event Description & Technical Handbook: Provide information on match rules, equipment inspections, dress code, and competition guidelines.
  3. Sanctioning Standard: Select whether the tournament adheres to World Archery rules or national federation guidelines.
  4. Venue Name & Full Address: Specify the stadium, sports complex, or archery field location so archers can easily navigate with GPS.
  5. Range Type: Select whether your competition is Outdoor Open Field, Indoor Sports Hall, or Covered Shooting Line.

4. Registration & Match Timelines

Set four key timeline milestones for your championship:

  • Registration Open Date: The exact date and time when participants can begin registering and paying online.
  • Registration Deadline (Close Date): When public registrations close so your committee can prepare target rosters and print accreditation badges.
  • Tournament Start Date: Official practice day or the first qualification session.
  • Tournament End Date: Gold medal finals, podium ceremony, and certificate distribution.

5. Draft Mode & Next Configuration Steps

Click Create & Save Draft. Your event workspace is now active!

From your tournament management panel, you can now proceed to:

  • Step 2: Adding Categories: Define bow disciplines (Recurve, Compound, Barebow), age divisions (U-12, U-15, Senior), and target distances.
  • Step 3: Qualification Sessions: Set number of arrows per end, target face sizes, and scoring sessions.
  • Step 4: Publishing: Flip your tournament to Published when you're ready to accept athlete registrations!
